trigger: P0583-P0584 showed that one global centroid-return pattern is mostly misaligned in RX J2129 and that smooth no-cross travel is preferable. Prior project work also found small gains from local baryonic directions.
question: Can multiple baryon-derived local attractors improve held-out RX J2129 roots more consistently than one global centroid when every route uses smooth no-cross travel?

formula.local_attractor: c_i=sum_{j!=i} w_j K_ij x_j / sum_{j!=i} w_j K_ij

fit_policy: Hold the P0583 scalar geometry and source positions fixed; fit no parameter.
selection: Among all-root rows, minimize held-out RMS. This is opened-data screening only.
claim_limits: RX J2129 is opened development data and selects no predictive coefficient.
The member-light catalog is an incomplete baryon proxy without registered gas or diffuse ICL.
A candidate must transfer unchanged to other exact-root clusters before it has evidential value.
The weak-field angular correction remains phenomenological rather than covariantly derived.
